headline: Weathered Expanse Post Turns Warden; Linn Mercy Closes Neutral Gap
war_summary: Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse has erased its neutral gap: a fifth position now flies the Warden color, leaving four under the Colonial banner. Linn Mercy has likewise closed its last breach, reporting eleven Colonial posts, with Lathair still the busiest name. Fishermans Row closes all Colonial after another active round at Black Well, Dankana Post, Arcadia, and Eidolo; the latest returns came near the evening report. Farranac Coast remains eleven Colonial, Transient Valley and The Bone Haft having shown the most motion earlier in the day. Stlican Shelf still holds five Warden posts to four Colonial, with Thornhold quiet, while Stonecradle lists three Warden to six Colonial and has again drawn the heaviest casualty tolls. Gutter remains solidly Warden, The Parras its liveliest point. Casualty ledgers for the past day run highest at Stonecradle and Weathered Expanse, with enlistments remaining strong in both. War 140 remains undecided, with neither side at the thirty-four victory towns required.
